title: texts-seen.json — what text systems a game showed while UGT Mod ran
description: Written by UGT Mod in its data folder (beside config.json), read by UGT Manager. A set that only grows while the game runs, rewritten when it does. It says what the game SHOWED; what the game merely CONTAINS is read from its files by the Manager and is not written here. Vocabulary: common/src/TextSystems.cs.

format.description: TextSystems.Format. A reader meeting a higher number reads what it knows and names the rest.

systems.description: The systems met. input-* are input fields, whose own text is what the player typed.

other.description: Text components the mod handles generically and knows by type name only (none of the systems above).

mod_version.description: The UGT Mod that wrote the file: an older one may not have known every system.
